Open qualified pipeline value

The sum of normalized deal amounts for unique open opportunities meeting the agreed qualification criteria and expected-close horizon at a defined snapshot.

Level 4Inspect the detail

The sum of normalized deal amounts for unique open opportunities meeting the agreed qualification criteria and expected-close horizon at a defined snapshot.

currency

How we use it

We assess available sales opportunity, stage concentration, ownership, and potential gaps against the sales plan.

Transparent calculationSum of normalized amounts for unique open qualified opportunities within the agreed snapshot and close horizon
qualified opportunity amounts12,000; 18,000; 25,000

12,000 + 18,000 + 25,000 = 55,000 currency units of open qualified pipeline.

Illustrative calculation. Not a client result or a universal benchmark.

Break the result down

  • Stage and expected-close horizon
  • Owner and segment
  • Pipeline source and currency

Questions we investigate

  • Are qualified deals stale or missing amounts?
  • Is value concentrated in a few opportunities?
  • Did stage, currency, or close dates shift?

Actions the evidence supports

  • Review qualification and stale opportunities.
  • Separate weighted forecasts from pipeline totals.
  • Assign next actions and verify deal ownership.

Reporting contract

Ownership & cadence

Revenue operations lead
Weekly at a fixed snapshot; monthly for planning.

Required data

  • Unique opportunity IDs and normalized amounts
  • Open status, qualification, and close dates
  • Snapshot timestamp and currency policy

Read the measure with context

An empty eligible set totals zero. Missing amounts require explicit exceptions. This is unweighted potential, not realized revenue or a probability-weighted forecast. Currency normalization, qualification consistency, stale deals, and close-date movement influence the value.
